Steps.Speaker: Brakka
Steps.Line: Road's washed out, and the dead don't much care for company.

Steps.Speaker: Brakka
Steps.Line: Clear us a path east to those ruins and we'll make camp somewhere dry.

Steps.Speaker: Odessa
Steps.Line: Mind the pools, dear. Things live in them. Well... 'live'.

Steps.Speaker: Brakka
Steps.Line: There's the gate... and THAT is exactly why we hired you.

Steps.Speaker: Brakka
Steps.Line: Clear the way. We'll bring the wagon up behind you.

Steps.Speaker: Brakka
Steps.Line: HA! Not bad. Not bad at all.

Steps.Speaker: Odessa
Steps.Line: Dry, defensible, and riddled with things to study. The ruins will do nicely.

Steps.Speaker: Brakka
Steps.Line: We'll bring the wagon through and get a roof up — come along when you're ready.

Steps.Speaker: Brakka
Steps.Line: Roof over our heads at last. Get the cart unhitched — we're staying.

Steps.Speaker: Odessa
Steps.Line: Those stairs go DOWN. Old places keep their best things below.

Steps.Speaker: Odessa
Steps.Line: Head down and see if you can find anything useful. We'll hold the camp.

Steps.Speaker: Maren
Steps.Line: That scroll — look at the seals. It isn't a letter. It's a DOOR.

Steps.Speaker: Maren
Steps.Line: Set it on the podium out east. The portal opens onto whatever world the seals describe.

Steps.Speaker: Maren
Steps.Line: There will be more of them below, and stranger. Bring me anything ancient you find in there.
